status: analytical proposal; no new RTL measurements

selected_macro.name: ot_rom_4096x274_m8
selected_macro.warning: Actual contextual SS/FF closure required. Two alternating macros produce one word/cycle, not two.

compute_interface.retained_unpack_pipeline: stage1 latch line/tag, stage2 unpack plus x fragment; do not add the same pipeline twice to inherited MMA drain

conversion_rules.FP4: Four ROM words r0..r3; for i=0..3 place ri[127:0] at weights[256*i+:128], ri[263:136] at weights[256*i+128+:128], ri[135:128] at scale[2*i], ri[271:264] at scale[2*i+1]. Discard ri[273:272]. Existing SM zero-extends each E2M1 nibble to byte; no float conversion.
conversion_rules.FP8: Four ROM words; ri[255:0] -> weights[256*i+:256], ri[263:256] -> scale[i]. Zero unused scales[4:8]. Discard ri[273:264]. Existing SM zeroes unused four block lanes.
conversion_rules.BF16: Four ROM words; ri[255:0] -> weights[256*i+:256]. Zero all scale slots; discard ri[273:256].
conversion_rules.FP32: Four ROM words can convey 32 FP32 values using low256 bits per word, but existing SM lacks FP32 mode. Route to retained exact FP32 unit; do not reinterpret as BF16.

mapping_obligations: Reencode immutable words in existing SM issue order, preserving every checkpoint code/scale and golden chunk/tree assignment. Native ROM FP4 pairs sibling chunks, so blindly concatenating sequential native addresses is not proven to match SM grouping.
Do not replace FP8 weights converted to BF16 by golden (wo_a) with ordinary FP8 block-dot semantics. Either store offline exact BF16 expansion or price exact source-format conversion.
Retain address bounds, descriptor format, epoch, request identity, masks, finite credits, SRAM/link/control protection. No ROM parity or SECDED sidecars.
No implicit compression/decompression benefit: layout transform is bit-permutation and zero fill; arithmetic decoded by retained compute engine.

266bit_alternative.caveat: 266 is not a generic no-ECC replacement width; wider released-scale payload must be accounted. Dense crossword packing adds alignment reservoir and changes source calendar.

new_logic_lower_bound.swizzle_basis: Fixed wires if format-specific sources selected upstream; shared runtime format adds format-select muxes to price. Address-based pool selection is separate.
